Cached-input billing is unverified. cost_usd_lower_bound is a known-usage subtotal/lower bound under this price assumption, not a lower bound on an actual invoice. Local hardware, electricity, idle capacity and hosting overhead are excluded.

limitations: The original holdout is reused validation, not unseen confirmation.
Final-field scores and complete runtime traces do not establish every prose SOP obligation.
Provider costs are list-price usage estimates, with cached input priced at full input rate; actual cache billing is unverified.
The pilot is retained separately from the 1,440 holdout executions; do not pool its accuracy into the holdout comparison.
Three domain processes each allow four cases; latency includes shared hosted-service contention.
scope: Offline evidence integrity; completed schedules only; no semantic gate-quality verdict
